name: b200_multibox
_comment: NVIDIA HGX/DGX Blackwell B200 multi-box deployment template (8-GPU NVLink5 islands stitched by ConnectX-8 XDR InfiniBand at ~2.5 us/100 GB/s). num_devices and ib.ports are auto-overridden by `system_with_eta(..., num_devices=N)` to match the declared cluster size; the JSON's defaults (16 GPUs, 2 boxes) are nominal placeholders. Intra-box: NVLink5 1.8 TB/s bidir (900 GB/s single-direction) per GPU through 4 NVSwitch5 chips. Inter-box: ConnectX-8 XDR (800 Gbps = 100 GB/s single-direction per GPU). A collective <=8 ranks stays on nvlink5; collectives spanning multiple boxes escalate to ib (paying alpha = 0.5 + 2.5 = 3.0 us, BW-floored to 100 GB/s). Checked against the vendor's product page in November 2026: DGX B200 lists 1,440 GB of GPU memory (180 GB per GPU) and eight single-port ConnectX-7 adapters at up to 400 Gb/s, so the inter-box tier is 50 GB/s per port (it was entered as 100 GB/s, which is the ConnectX-8 rate of DGX B300).
